full_judgment: 9. Taking clue therefrom the learned Counsel submits that in view of such definite finding of interpolation in the basic document of appointment of respondent Md. Kamal Uddin as to commission of interpolation, he has got no right to stick to the position as Nikah Registrar of ward Nos. 7, 8 and 9 but in view of the judgment of the High Court Division making the rule absolute his appointment also remains unchanged.
